# Kodra macOS — Full Documentation for LLMs

> Comprehensive technical reference for AI assistants and language models.

## Overview

Kodra macOS is a one-command Azure developer environment for macOS on Apple Silicon. It installs and configures 40+ cloud-native development tools with zero manual configuration. Built by [Code To Cloud Inc.](https://www.codetocloud.io) in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.

- **Version**: 0.5.0
- **Platform**: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later, Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)
- **License**: MIT
- **Website**: https://kodra.macos.codetocloud.io
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/codetocloudorg/kodra-macos

## Installation

```bash
curl -fsSL https://kodra.macos.codetocloud.io/boot.sh | bash
```

This clones the repo to `~/.kodra` and runs `install.sh`, which:
1. Checks macOS version and Apple Silicon architecture
2. Installs/updates Homebrew
3. Presents an interactive 6-option install menu (Full / Minimal / Developer / Cloud Engineer / Uninstall Kodra / Exit)
4. Installs all selected tools via Homebrew formulae, casks, and native .pkg
5. Configures shell (zsh), terminal (Ghostty), prompt (Starship), and macOS defaults
6. Logs everything to `~/.local/state/kodra/install.log`

## Tools Installed

### CLI Tools (19)
- **bat** — Cat with syntax highlighting (`brew install bat`)
- **btop** — System resource monitor (`brew install btop`)
- **delta** — Beautiful git diffs with syntax highlighting (`brew install git-delta`)
- **direnv** — Per-directory environment variables (`brew install direnv`)
- **eza** — Modern `ls` replacement (`brew install eza`)
- **fastfetch** — System info display (`brew install fastfetch`)
- **fd** — Modern `find` replacement (`brew install fd`)
- **fzf** — Fuzzy finder (`brew install fzf`)
- **gh** — GitHub CLI (`brew install gh`)
- **gh copilot** — GitHub Copilot CLI (`gh extension install github/gh-copilot`)
- **httpie** — Human-friendly HTTP client (`brew install httpie`)
- **jq** — JSON processor (`brew install jq`)
- **lazygit** — Git TUI (`brew install lazygit`)
- **neovim** — Terminal editor (`brew install neovim`)
- **ripgrep** — Fast grep replacement (`brew install ripgrep`)
- **shellcheck** — Shell script linter (`brew install shellcheck`)
- **tldr** — Simplified man pages (`brew install tldr`)
- **yq** — YAML processor (`brew install yq`)
- **zoxide** — Smart `cd` command (`brew install zoxide`)
- **act** — Run GitHub Actions locally (`brew install act`)

### Cloud & Infrastructure (11)
- **az** — Azure CLI (`brew install azure-cli`)
- **azd** — Azure Developer CLI (`brew install azd`)
- **bicep** — Azure Bicep (`az bicep install`)
- **terraform** — HashiCorp Terraform (`brew install terraform`)
- **tofu** — OpenTofu (`brew install opentofu`)
- **kubectl** — Kubernetes CLI (`brew install kubectl`)
- **helm** — Kubernetes package manager (`brew install helm`)
- **k9s** — Kubernetes TUI (`brew install k9s`)
- **pwsh** — PowerShell 7 (native `.pkg` from Microsoft GitHub releases)
- **oc** — OpenShift CLI (`brew install openshift-cli`)
- **ansible** — Red Hat Ansible automation (`brew install ansible`)

### Containers (3–4, user chooses Docker or Podman stack)
- **colima** — Lightweight container runtime, replaces Docker Desktop (`brew install colima`)
- **docker** — Docker CLI + Compose plugin (`brew install docker docker-compose`)
- **lazydocker** — Docker TUI (`brew install lazydocker`)
- **podman** — Daemonless container engine (`brew install podman`)
- **podman-compose** — Compose support for Podman (`brew install podman-compose`)
- **Podman Desktop** — GUI for managing containers, images, pods (`brew install --cask podman-desktop`)
- **podman-docker** — Docker CLI compatibility shim (`brew install podman-docker`)
- **trivy** — Container & IaC security scanner (`brew install trivy`)
- **dive** — Explore container image layers (`brew install dive`)

> During install, users choose either the Docker stack (Colima + Docker CLI + lazydocker) or the Podman stack (Podman + Podman Desktop + podman-compose). Both are license-free.

### Terminal & Shell (4)
- **Ghostty** — GPU-accelerated terminal with Tokyo Night theme (`brew install --cask ghostty`)
- **Starship** — Cross-shell prompt with Kodra config (`brew install starship`)
- **Nerd Fonts** — JetBrainsMono + Meslo fonts (`brew install --cask font-jetbrains-mono-nerd-font`)
- **Shell config** — zsh aliases, completions, FZF integration at `~/.config/kodra/shell.zsh`

### Developer Tools (2)
- **mise** — Polyglot runtime manager for Node, Python, Go, etc. (`brew install mise`)
- **VS Code** — Editor with Copilot + Azure extensions (`brew install --cask visual-studio-code`)

### macOS Defaults
Developer-optimized system settings via `defaults write`:
- Fast key repeat (InitialKeyRepeat=15, KeyRepeat=2), disabled autocorrect
- Dock: auto-hide, minimize-to-application, no recent apps, small icon size
- Finder: show all extensions, hidden files, path bar, status bar
- Dark mode with purple accent color
- Screenshots saved to `~/Screenshots` as PNG

## CLI Commands

```bash
kodra doctor          # Check 40+ tools across 4 categories
kodra doctor --fix    # Auto-reinstall missing tools
kodra update          # brew update && brew upgrade
kodra cleanup         # brew cleanup + cache purge
kodra repair          # Interactive repair menu
kodra repair --all    # Repair all tools automatically
kodra backup          # Create dotfile/config backup
kodra backup list     # List available backups
kodra backup restore  # Restore from backup
kodra setup           # Re-run first-time configuration
kodra dev             # Show dev environment info
kodra extensions      # Manage VS Code extensions
kodra fetch           # System info via fastfetch
kodra defaults        # Re-apply macOS developer settings
kodra refresh         # Reload shell configuration
kodra shortcuts       # Show all configured aliases
kodra version         # Show Kodra version
kodra help            # Show all available commands
```

## Architecture

```
kodra-macos/
├── boot.sh                 # Bootstrap (curl | bash entry point)
├── install.sh              # Main orchestrator with interactive menu
├── uninstall.sh            # Clean removal of all tools
├── bin/kodra               # CLI tool (30+ subcommands)
├── lib/
│   ├── logging.sh          # Color output helpers
│   ├── utils.sh            # run_installer, brew_install, has_command
│   ├── checks.sh           # macOS version, Apple Silicon, Homebrew checks
│   ├── state.sh            # JSON state management via python3
│   ├── backup.sh           # Dotfile backup/restore
│   ├── config.sh           # Key=value settings management
│   ├── ui.sh               # ASCII banners, progress, spinners
│   └── package.sh          # Homebrew package abstraction
├── install/
│   ├── cli-tools/          # 19 CLI tool installers
│   ├── cloud/              # 11 cloud tool installers
│   ├── containers/         # 6 container tool installers (docker or podman + trivy, dive)
│   ├── dev-tools/          # 2 dev tool installers
│   ├── terminal/           # 4 terminal/shell installers
│   └── desktop/            # 3 macOS defaults scripts
├── uninstall/              # Per-tool uninstallers + full uninstall script
├── migrations/             # Version migration scripts
├── configs/
│   ├── btop.conf           # btop configuration
│   ├── fastfetch.jsonc     # fastfetch configuration
│   ├── aliases.sh          # Shell aliases
│   └── completions/        # zsh + bash completions for kodra
├── packages/               # Package lists (cli-tools, core, cloud, etc.)
├── tests/
│   ├── unit/               # 313 structural tests
│   └── integration/        # Full install E2E tests
├── docs/                   # FAQ, troubleshooting, cheatsheet, roadmap
└── .github/workflows/
    ├── ci.yml              # Lint + unit tests on macos-15
    └── e2e.yml             # Full install E2E on Apple Silicon
```

## Key Paths

- **Kodra home**: `~/.kodra`
- **Config**: `~/.config/kodra/`
- **Settings**: `~/.config/kodra/settings`
- **Shell config**: `~/.config/kodra/shell.zsh`
- **State**: `~/.local/state/kodra/state.json`
- **Backups**: `~/.config/kodra/backups/`
- **Install log**: `~/.local/state/kodra/install.log`
- **Homebrew**: `/opt/homebrew` (Apple Silicon) or `/usr/local` (Intel)

## Comparison with Kodra Variants

| Feature | Kodra (Ubuntu) | Kodra WSL | Kodra macOS |
|---------|---------------|-----------|-------------|
| OS | Ubuntu 24.04 | WSL2 Ubuntu | macOS 14+ |
| Package Manager | apt | apt | Homebrew + .pkg |
| Desktop | GNOME | Windows Terminal | Native macOS |
| Docker | Docker CE | Docker CE | Colima or Podman |
| Terminal | Ghostty | Oh My Posh | Ghostty + Starship |
| Architecture | x86_64/arm64 | x86_64 | Apple Silicon |
| Shell | bash | bash | zsh |
| CI Runners | ubuntu-24.04 | windows-2022 | macos-15 |

## Uninstall

```bash
bash ~/.kodra/uninstall.sh
```

Or select **option 5** from the install menu. The uninstaller removes **everything**: all Homebrew formulae (41), all casks (6 apps), PowerShell.app, gh-copilot extension, config files, VS Code Kodra settings, shell config, launchd plists, Podman/Colima data, and all Kodra directories. Only Homebrew itself is preserved.

For granular per-tool removal:
```bash
bash ~/.kodra/uninstall/azure-cli.sh
bash ~/.kodra/uninstall/colima.sh
bash ~/.kodra/uninstall/vscode.sh
```
